shipping.cutOffTime: Orders placed before 2pm Pacific ship the same business day.
shipping.note: Delivery estimates are for transit after dispatch and exclude weekends and public holidays.

returns.condition: Unused and in the original packaging.
returns.cost: Free return label for orders shipped within the United States.
returns.refundProcessingDays: 5 to 7 business days after the return arrives
returns.exclusionReason: Hygiene and safety items cannot be returned once opened.

warranty.default: 24 months on electronics, 12 months on everything else unless the product lists a different period.
warranty.excludes: Accidental damage, normal wear, and water damage on products without a stated water resistance rating.
warranty.claimProcess: Reply to this conversation with a photo and the order number; an agent opens the claim.

payment.currencyNote: All prices are charged in USD.

discountCodes: Promotional codes are issued only by the marketing team; support agents cannot create or apply them.
stockNote: Stock levels reflect units on hand right now. We do not publish restock dates; an agent can check with the warehouse on request.
